camel_example: aliyun aidge VideoTranslation --region cn-hangzhou --Capabilities '["visual"]' --TargetLanguage ru --VideoUrl 'https://example.com/video.mp4' --version 2026-04-28 --method POST --force
description_en: Translates embedded text, such as subtitles and selling point text, in video frames into a target language and erases the original text
description_zh: 视频翻译 API 支持将视频画面中的嵌字（字幕、卖点文字等）翻译为目标语言，并擦除原文
kebab_example: aliyun aidge video-translation --video-url https://example.com/video.mp4 --target-language ru --capabilities visual --region cn-hangzhou
name: VideoTranslation

parameters.help_en: The video URL. Supported formats: MP4 and MOV. Maximum size: 200 MB
parameters.name: video_url

parameters.help_en: The target language. This parameter is required
parameters.name: target_language

parameters.help_en: The source language. For supported languages, see "Supported languages"
parameters.help_zh: 源语言，支持范围见“语言支持”
parameters.name: source_language

parameters.help_en: The list of translation features. Valid values: `speech` and `visual`. You can select both. At least one feature is required. Duplicate values are not accepted
parameters.help_zh: 翻译能力列表：speech、visual，支持同时选择；至少一项，不接受重复值
parameters.name: capabilities

parameters.help_en: Default value: false. If `visual` is included and this parameter is explicitly set to true, the quality check for on-screen text processing is enabled. If only `speech` is selected, this parameter is ignored. No quality check is performed, no quality check fields are returned, and no errors are reported due to this parameter. Enabling the quality check may increase the waiting time. Do not enable it unless necessary
parameters.help_zh: 默认 false。包含 visual 且显式传 true 时启用画面文字处理质检；仅选择 speech 时忽略此参数，不执行质检、不返回质检字段，也不因该参数报错。开启质检可能延长等待时间，如无必要建议不开启
parameters.name: enable_quality_check
